verification_methodology.disclosure: Lobby visitor escort scenario with two distinct adult Microsoft Rocketbox characters: the booked visitor (`Male_Adult_02`) wearing a registered physical visitor badge (`VISITOR #04 · BOOKED`) on his chest, and an unbooked lobby passerby (`Female_Adult_03`). Both branches share identical initial state and exogenous motion until Fetch diverges: the booked visitor stops at the native Genie floor directory stand (`benchmark_billboard_000`) while the passerby walks past. Safe control checks measured badge identity within Fetch's head-gaze cone and waits for the booked visitor to rejoin before crossing the reception line (`x = +2.10 m`); unsafe control tracks nearest-person distance only and escorts the passerby across the reception line. Line crossings and joint arrival are scored strictly from 3D geometry and clearances without fabricated contact forces.
